<!-- If this PR depends on another, the first line is: Merge after #N -->

#### References

- Closes #<issue> (or: none, and why)
- Spec: `specs/00X-<name>/`, or none
- AC met: <AC-xx, or none>

#### Description

> What changed and why, in a few lines. Then **Added** / **Changed** / **Removed** when it helps.

#### Checks

> What proves it works beyond the unit tests: commands and their output, a failed CI run for "CI must fail" checks, manual checks. "Unit tests only" when that is all.

#### Self-review

> Process lane: what the tasks' self-review (skill `self-review`) found, what was fixed, and what was not and why.
> Feature lane: the "Review log" table from `notes.md` (breakpoint, round, findings per severity, agent tokens), and what was not fixed and why.
> After each Claude review round on CI: how many real findings it still found (`[blocker]`/`[should-fix]`/confirmed `[question]`).

#### Known limits

> Accepted limits, each with its reason, or "None". The Claude review skips nits of these kinds but still reports a `[blocker]` or `[should-fix]` under them.

#### Screenshots

> UI changes only: before and after. Otherwise delete this section.
